title: Serve potato salad with a squeeze disher
instruction: Serve two portions of potato salad onto the plate using the squeeze disher. Keep the bowl and plate upright in place. Put the disher down and finish with both hands clear.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; table top is height0. Coordinates are metres, x forward from the arm-base line and y left from its midpoint (bases y+/-0.305). Nothing is clamped. A: (1) A loose generic squeeze disher, approximately239mm long,58.4mm maximum handle span,155g in total. Its open face points down and its handle points away from the arms: body origin(0.255,0,0.00075), yaw180deg, cup centre(0.140,0,0.00075). The hemispherical working cavity has23.1mm radius and depth(25.816mL); shell1mm thick. Fixed handle165x18x14mm; sprung handle160x14x14mm,0to0.13rad about its front pivot. An8g semicircular wiper,43.4mm across, is geared through180deg by that handle travel. Base123g, handle24g; unloaded return spring torque0.99to1.38Nm at the handle pivot (estimated). (2) A loose polypropylene bowl centred(0.160,-0.140,0),150mm inside diameter,60mm tall,5mm floor,180g empty. It contains approximately432.32mL(453.94g at the proxy density) of soft cold potato salad: a35mm-deep central128mm-wide patch, below its rim. (3) An empty loose melamine serving plate centred(0.160,-0.350,0),170mm diameter,5mm floor and17mm rim height,160g. All dimensions and component masses are estimates for this generic model, except the cited catalogue references. B: disher origin(0.205,0,0.00075), bowl(0.140,-0.140,0), plate(0.140,-0.350,0); all else identical. Trials run on A and B and are averaged; setup image shows A. Real trials use cold prepared food and food-safe replaceable pad covers, a clean washable counter and cleaning between trials. Proposed physical source: Reser's Original Potato Salad, same product lot, chilled2–4C, no added water; ten gentle folds then432+/-5mL in a roughly128mm central footprint,35+/-2mm deep. Record measured starting mass/depth/temperature, remove templates, and follow README cleaning/pad-cover/reset protocol. The commercial food has not calibrated the simulated density or rheology.
scoring: End score0,0.5or1, using material state and measured object/link poses, with continuous primary violation history. Credit requires food carried from source to plate inside the disher; direct gripper/fingertip-food contact anywhere makes the whole trial zero. Native post-physics full convex hand hulls are checked against source, cavity, flying, plated and recorded spilled material boxes; unknown geometry gives zero. Real trials require continuous unobstructed video establishing this tool-carried route and no direct hand-food contact; an unverified portion earns no credit. A serving is a separate connected mound on the plate (8mm material cells joined along edges or corners), each at least14mL, with at least34mL delivered in total and no more than3mL spilled. At the proxy density these are14.7g per mound,35.7g total and3.15g spill. Two touching heaps count as one. The bowl and plate must remain within30mm of their starting centres and10deg of upright throughout, observed at native physics rate with1um position and1e-9 cosine numerical margins. Unknown/non-finite primary material or pose state, non-advancing time or a step gap over0.1s invalidates the trial. Full credit also needs no food in flight and a final contiguous2s interval with all three props supported by actual table contact, still (every shape corner under10mm/s, root spin under0.1rad/s), and both hands still and entirely released. All gripper/fingertip collision faces are sampled at3mm;12mm sampled clearance certifies greater than5mm after sampling/merge allowance. All other arm links also require conservative5mm separation. The food volumes are included in release geometry. The final certificate covers the actual joints, link poses and material state and cannot be reused after change. With the same complete release, support, stillness and primary history gates,0.5 is awarded for at least one separate14mL mound with no more than3mL spilled if the full two-portion amount is incomplete; otherwise0. Final support/release/stillness is sampled at20Hz. Material/history counters must advance together. Volume comparisons use1uL numerical margin. The2s hold restarts whenever the credited tier changes. Final prop vertical cosine must exceed0.995(about5.73deg upright) and every lowest point must be within4mm of tabletop. Force thresholds and force-telemetry availability are not primary score gates in simulation or reality. Independent robot safety settings and alarms are documented in README. Real-trial grading: weigh the two separate mounds on a0.1g scale, weigh all food outside the source/tool/plate, and use the complete video for bowl/plate movement, uprightness, stable table support and hands clear. No body-weld or command-angle proof of ejection is permitted. Trials run on A and B and are averaged.
reset_notes: Clean and dry tool/bowl/plate, replace contaminated food-safe pad covers and restore each published visible layout. Tool empty/open/inverted, wiper at rim, plate empty. Fresh source per README; all simulated material/primary violation, independent safety and exposure histories and native friction reset together. Only real return-spring rest target is set; no prop pose correction occurs during a trial.
context: Restaurant food preparation and serving include portioning soft salad with a squeeze disher. Food clings to the cup after acquisition; the internal wiper frees it. An early release spills it before it reaches the plate. This task tests acquisition and controlled ejection, rather than striking a scoop level or weighing an exact dose.
fidelity: Full-size generic disher; geometry/masses,24.17gear,spring,6mm contact patch estimated. Conserved8mm food/cavity voxels;2kPa loading work and40mNm wipe friction uncalibrated. Native240Hz coupling;50ms effective-acceleration mean and35m/s2 adhesion estimate. No chunks or physical hand-food response: full convex hand/material-box overlap instead latches forbidden contact. Parcels/spill use conservative cube proxies. Independent40N finger drive cap, not a primary force score.
scores: Revised runtime, 1200-step limit per layout: expert demo 1.0 in A and B; Dream-1 0.0 in A and B (step limit, never grasped the disher). Pre-revision runs (expert 1.0/1.0, Dream-1 0.0/0.0) predate the hand-food gate and 40 N drive cap and are historical.
run_limit: 1200control steps(60secondsat20Hz) perlayout; A and B are run with --epochs2 and averaged.
